data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that displays an animated gradient line, useful as a divider in AppBar or other UI parts.
data.what_it_does: It renders a thin line whose colors animate with a gradient effect. The widget can be placed anywhere, commonly as the bottom of an AppBar. It supports a Material 3 flag to match the theme.
use_when: You need a simple animated divider without writing custom animation code
You want a ready‑made gradient line for AppBar bottom or similar UI sections
avoid_when: You require extensive animation control or custom shapes
You need a non‑gradient or static divider
strengths: Very small API, just drop the widget
weaknesses: Limited customization (only gradient and Material 3 flag)
No parameters for animation speed or direction

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar animated gradient effect and is more configurable for loading placeholders
